# .github/waybeam-overlay/MANIFEST.txt
# Source-of-truth contract for the Waybeam overlay. `tools/waybeam-overlay-gen.sh`
# reads this to regenerate files/ + patches/ from the live tree. One path per
# line; `=` separates action from path. Comments (#) and blank lines ignored.
#
#   add  <path>            copy live path verbatim into files/<path>
#   patch <path>           emit git diff upstream..HEAD as patches/<sanitized>.patch
#
# Add files here ONLY if they are pure additions to upstream (no upstream
# counterpart). Patch files here ONLY if upstream owns the file and your
# change is surgical. If upstream adopts/abandons a file, move it between
# `add` and `patch` accordingly and re-run the generator + commit.

add general/package/rtl88x2cu/Config.in
add general/package/rtl88x2cu/rtl88x2cu.mk
add .github/workflows/build-ssc338q.yml
add .gitlab-ci.yml
add README-Waybeam.md

patch general/package/Config.in
patch Makefile
patch br-ext-chip-sigmastar/configs/ssc338q_ultimate_defconfig
patch README.md
